name: file-hygiene-standard-writer
description: Writes a design team's file and tool conventions (naming, project structure, cover and status pages, archiving, branching, what lives in which tool), part of the DesignOps Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run file-hygiene-standard-writer", "how should we name our files", "Figma is a mess", "file naming convention", "where does everything live", "tool stack rules", or when a new hire cannot find the current version of anything. Use it even for a vague "our files are chaos".
